v0.1.0.note: the build: a 44-card Sharknado core and 24 named lands kept, the builder filled 18 spells and 12 lands

v1.0.2.note: Astral Drift -> Shelter and Gleaming Bastion -> a basic Island, both made in cardboard. The Island is the deck's first basic: Gleaming Bastion's W/U mode is gated on controlling one, so at zero basics it made {C} from the turn after it entered.

v1.1.0.note: The four swaps the pilot made in cardboard on 2026-10-01: Negate, Mask of Memory, Marauding Mako and Swords to Plowshares for Decree of Silence, Gossip's Talent, Marketback Walker and Stromkirk Noble. MINOR by the semver rule — four swaps that move the measured axes, not a land pass. Three of the four cuts were filler by the builder's own score and two were found by the pilot's eye.
